stages.log: A Halloran runner limps home on one engine, and her medic would rather not go with her. The family's runner: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. Her medic would sign on, given a berth.

objectives.text: Tow her, sign on Dez, or Tow her in
objectives.done-when: events.chose(event: runner, choice: towjoin) or events.chose(event: runner, choice: tow)

stages.fail-when: events.chose(event: runner, choice: rob) or run.past-charts
stages.why: It went cold: take her cargo.
